component.name: Papillon
component.summary: Sticky notes floating on your desktop
Des notes flottantes sur votre bureau

description.p: Papillon puts sticky notes on your desktop, each in its own small window, in English and French.
Papillon pose des notes sur votre bureau, chacune dans sa petite fenêtre, en français et en anglais.

ul.li: Notes come back where you left them, saved as you type
Les notes reviennent là où vous les avez laissées, enregistrées pendant la frappe
Sept couleurs, trois tailles de texte
Keep a note above the other windows
Une note peut rester au-dessus des autres fenêtres
A list to find, reopen and delete notes
Une liste pour retrouver, rouvrir et supprimer les notes
Starts with the computer if you wish
Démarre avec l’ordinateur si vous le souhaitez

screenshot.caption: Notes on the desktop, beside the list of notes

description.p: Safer backups: a damaged file never replaces a good one, twin notes are kept, a file changed by another program is copied first. A long note keeps its place when its strip is clicked. Fonts appear without waiting, and a trapped font can't crash the app. Keyboard access backwards through long lists and in the licenses.

Notes can't crash the app or vanish through a damaged file or font: damaged values are repaired, any file not understood is first copied, and the previous version is kept. Autosave goes on when a note is minimized. Closing the list warns if saving fails. Complete licenses, keyboard access to long lists, more writing systems.

Notes are safer: an unreadable file is never overwritten, and a failed save says so. A minimized note reopens from the list, typing goes on after a button, the scroll bar can be dragged, and notes can't get lost on a monitor that is gone. Keyboard moves, more writing systems, better contrast.
First version: notes on the desktop, colors, keeping on top, a list with search, starting with the computer.
